Hi Samantha —

Thank you again for agreeing to be a brief reference for our platform last week. Our advocacy team asked me to follow up on thank-you options so we can honor AtlasCloud without adding friction to your team. We usually offer a combination of: a service credit (applied to your account), a small swag package, or a donation in your company's name to a charity of your choice.

Options I can set up quickly:
- $1,000 credit applied to your Redwood account (one-time invoice credit)
- Redwood swag box (hoodie, stickers, travel mug) — we’ll ship to a corporate address
- $1,000 charitable donation and we’ll send a receipt for your records

Can you confirm which you prefer? If swag, please send a shipping address and contact. If donation, send the legal name of the nonprofit and any requirements for the receipt. If you want a split (e.g., $500 credit + $500 donation), we can do that too.

Appreciate your help — we’ll finalize within 48 hours once you confirm.

Best,
Laura Bennett
